name: Auto Continue
description: Continues agents stopped at their usage limit in their own CanvasTTY card: the reset time comes from CanvasTTY's limits and the continue message is typed into that card after the reset.
description.ru: Продолжает агентов, упёршихся в лимит, в их же карточке CanvasTTY: время сброса берётся из лимитов CanvasTTY, после сброса в эту карточку пишется сообщение «продолжай».
description.en: Continues agents stopped at their usage limit in their own CanvasTTY card: the reset time comes from CanvasTTY's limits and the continue message is typed into that card after the reset.
author: tab11pm

services.title: Auto Continue
services.description: Watches agent cards for a usage-limit stop, takes the reset time from CanvasTTY's limits, and types the continue message into the same card after the reset.
